Restrained warm morning illumination, no glare. Only modest integrated architectural ledges at the extreme sides; no loose furniture.

No humans, owls, animals, aliens, robots, characters, faces, eyes or living creatures. No text, letters, numbers, labels, book titles, symbols, logos, watermark, prices, buttons, menus, UI, educational cards or interface placeholders. No busy texture, sparkles, clutter, central furniture, center rug, split panels, storyboard, or animation effects. Render only the static background; do not implement the interaction.
